name: Röko AB (publ)
summary: Röko AB (publ), a private equity firm founded in 2019, focuses its investment activities on small and medium-sized enterprises. Based in Stockholm, Sweden, the company targets opportunities across Europe, with a specific interest in both business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) markets. Typically, Röko seeks out companies that exhibit an EBITDA between €2 million (approximately $21.40 million) and €10 million (approximately $107.4 million), alongside a profitability margin of at least 10%.
